response.sql: WITH order_invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT order_id, invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS invoice_share FROM order_invoice_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS total_invoices, a.avg_share AS average_share, AVG(s.invoice_share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE s.invoice_share > a.avg_share
